normalization_plan.reason: The _to parameter only exists to feed the transfer function and should be folded into it
The _value parameter is a transient input to transfer arithmetic and merges into the transfer function
The recipient parameter is only meaningful inside createTokens and is folded into that function
The ETH value parameter is a local input of createTokens and merges into it
The refund local is computed solely to be sent via recipient.transfer and merges into that unsafe operation
The val local is the residual ETH passed to the final recipient.transfer and merges into that unsafe operation
maxRefund is added into the leftover transfer amount and merges into that unsafe operation
